name: Clerk MCP
description: Manages Clerk authentication from AI agents: create and configure applications, list and create users, set up production instances, and fetch Clerk SDK snippets. For developers.

skills.name: Manage Applications
skills.description: Lists, inspects and creates Clerk applications in your workspace, returning each instance's publishable key.

skills.name: Instance Configuration
skills.description: Reads, updates or replaces a Clerk instance's configuration and reads its schema, with a dry-run preview before changes.

skills.name: Manage Users
skills.description: Finds users in a Clerk instance with filters, such as the most recent sign-ups, and creates new users in that instance.

skills.name: Production Setup
skills.description: Creates a production instance from development, checks domain DNS records, and sets production OAuth provider credentials.

skills.name: SDK Snippets
skills.description: Fetches a Clerk SDK code snippet for a feature, or a bundle for a common setup such as b2b-saas or organizations.
